title: camera_focus_pair/effect_cancel move the camera without updating last_sel_* — a later re-select of the still-selected node/link fires no camera ease
evidence:
app/main.odin:408: `if app.input.sel_node != app.last_sel_node || app.input.sel_pipe != app.last_sel_pipe {`
camera_focus_pair (app/main.odin:1165-1178) ends: `app.cam_wx_to = (ax + bx) / 2` / `app.cam_wy_to = (ay + by) / 2` / `app.cam_zoom_to = 2.6` — no last_sel_node/last_sel_pipe write.
effect_cancel (app/main.odin:687-690): `effect_cancel :: proc(user: rawptr, ictx: ^inp.Input) {` / `app := cast(^App)user` / `camera_set_fit(app)` / `}` — no last_sel update, no selection clear.
detail: Banner focus-zoom (or ESC during placement, which keeps the selection) moves cam targets while last_sel_* still equal sel_*. Re-clicking the already-selected node leaves the diff false, so camera_set_selection never runs — selection and camera disagree.
recommended_fix: In camera_focus_pair and effect_cancel, also set app.last_sel_node/app.last_sel_pipe to a sentinel (-1) that cannot equal a live selection id, so the next selection change always retargets.

title: ESC during an active draw fires on_cancel (camera eases home mid-drag); the pad's mid-draw escape (Cancel_Drag) never homes — same gesture, divergent camera paths
evidence:
app/input/exec.odin:47-54: `case Cancel:` / `if inp.on_cancel != nil { inp.on_cancel(inp.user, inp) } // 7.1: the camera-home exit (fires even when nothing is selected)` / `... // it never cancels an in-progress draw (the pad's B maps to` / `// Cancel_Drag for that).` — the Cancel case has no inp.drag.active gate.
app/input/controller.odin:54-59: `} else if inp.drag.active {` / `// abandon the in-progress draw (the pad's escape hatch — see` / `// Cancel_Drag)` / `append(out, Intent(Cancel_Drag{}))` / `} else {` / `append(out, Intent(Cancel{}))`.
detail: Mouse ESC mid-drag (mouse.odin:130-136 maps .Esc to Cancel unconditionally) homes the camera while the draw continues; pad B mid-drag abandons the draw with no camera change. One escape gesture, two camera outcomes across devices.
recommended_fix: Gate effect_cancel on !ictx.drag.active (skip the camera-home mid-draw), or fire the camera-home from Cancel_Drag too so both escape paths agree.

title: palcheck discards node_type_index/pipe_tier_index bools and topology_apply_edit results — a catalog id miss builds a wrong scene that can still pass green
evidence: harness/palcheck.odin:196-206: `res, _ := pp.node_type_index(cat, "residential")` / `host, _ := pp.node_type_index(cat, "content_host")` / `rtm, _ := pp.node_type_index(cat, "router_mid")` / ... `narrow, _ := pp.pipe_tier_index(cat, "narrow")` / `wide, _ := pp.pipe_tier_index(cat, "wide")` / `re1, _ := pp.topology_apply_edit(&state.topology, pp.Command{kind = pp.Cmd_Draw_Pipe{a = 0, b = 1, tier = narrow}}, cat)` — core/catalog.odin:1003-1008 returns `return 0, false` on a miss.
detail: On a renamed/reordered catalog the discarded false yields index 0 for every spawn; if index 0 is a router the router-to-router draws still succeed and the lane-stripe check can stay green on a semantically wrong scene.
recommended_fix: Return setup-failure (exit 2) when any lookup returns false or an apply_edit errors — the gate's scene must match the demo's intent exactly.
